summary: Owners invite an attendant by email, WhatsApp number or both (Workshop ewatrade/mobile/staff-invite-channels pick 01). retailOps.inviteStaff and the dashboard /api/staff invite take an optional email and an optional E.164 phone, at least one; RetailOpsStaffInviteToken gains a nullable phone. A WhatsApp-only attendant gets the internal phone-account email like phone sign-up. Contacts on two accounts, or a contact added to an account someone already uses, are refused; QA and live identities never mix. The WhatsApp invite is sent inline after commit from the platform sign-in number through an approved template (off until STAFF_INVITE_WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NAME/_LANGUAGE are set with WhatsApp sign-in on); its outcome is kept on the open invite and shown in the staff list. The attendant's first WhatsApp sign-in is allowed for the number on their open invite and verifies it. Email invites are unchanged. No Trigger runs added.
noAssistantImpact: No capability, tool, prompt or write path changes. The assistant's staff_invitation proposal and the staff invitation command path (resend/revoke, email outbox) are untouched and stay email-only; inviting by WhatsApp number is form-only on mobile and dashboard for now. The shared communications package only gains a separate staff-invite template sender; assistant WhatsApp channel code is not touched.

evidence.result: Contact normalisation, two-account conflict, linking only to never-claimed accounts, reuse of a verified phone account and WhatsApp outcome storage: pass (8).
Existing email invite tests plus WhatsApp-only invite and no-contact refusal: pass (18).
Existing phone auth tests plus an invited attendant's first WhatsApp sign-in verifying the invited number: pass (11).
No send for email-only or replayed invites; SENT/FAILED/NOT_CONFIGURED recorded; local profile logs the link and never calls Meta: pass (3).
Existing route tests plus a WhatsApp-only invite with no email and reported delivery: pass (11).

emulator-5554 at 100% and 200%: chips, inline errors, duplicate banner, email invite, resend and cancel pass; WhatsApp invite refused on the QA business (no managed QA phone) with a clear message; WhatsApp delivery not exercised end to end.
